relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: treatment with PGE2 for 24 h increased the current density of tetrodotoxin-sensitive (TTX-S) but not TTX-resistant (TTX-R) channels significantly

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: the mRNA level of TTX-S Nav1.1 but not TTX-R Nav1.8 or Nav1.9 was significantly increased after 24 h of treatment with PGE2.

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: 5-min treatment with PGE2 (10 μM) increased the peak sodium current density by approximately 29% and increased TTX-R sodium currents, but not TTX-S currents, in both small- and medium-sized TG neurons

key_findings: 24-h PGE2 increases TTX-S (not TTX-R) sodium current and Nav1.1 mRNA in trigeminal neurons, mostly medium-sized
Acute 5-min PGE2 increases TTX-R sodium current instead
